progression.narrative: The performance opens on Db4 and dwells most on Gb in Phrase 1. Phrase 5 (0:51.7) introduces Gb, centred on Ds. The line peaks at Gb4 (364.3 Hz) at 0:57.5. It closes on Gb4, not the tonic (Gb4 → Gb4).
